info.title: Weavit Platform API
info.description: REST API for Weavit productivity: roadmaps, habits, todos, deadlines, and timeline calendar.

get.description: Check operational health and database status
Reads the latest LeetCode submission for a username and reports whether it falls on the current day. A habit can use this as its check-in source.

200.description: Whether the latest submission counts for today

post.description: Ensures authenticated Clerk user is created/updated in the Prisma database

get.description: Fetch all active roadmaps and plans for authenticated user

200.description: Project details with nested phases and tasks
Array of user habits with streaks

post.description: Adds or removes today (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) from completedDates and recomputes streakCount.
Append a journal note for a habit. Does not mark the habit complete — use toggle for completion dates.

patch.description: Partial update for a deadline. Used by UI completion toggle and edits.

get.description: Returns the full CalendarWeek data set for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Update name/tone/visible (visibility toggle in CalendarWeek sidebar).
Partial update for drag/resize/edit in CalendarWeek.

phases.description: Optional nested phases (each may include tasks and notes)
Optional nested phases when replacing or seeding plan structure

tasks.description: Optional nested tasks for this phase

notes.description: Optional nested log notes for this task
Optional notes to append when updating a task

completedDates.description: Source of truth: calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD) the habit was completed

logs.description: Journal entries only; not used for completion

createdAt.description: Optional journal timestamp; defaults to now

CalendarSource.description: Named calendar used by CalendarWeek for color + visibility filtering

visible.description: When false, events on this calendar are hidden in CalendarWeek

CalendarEvent.description: Timed or all-day event block for CalendarWeek
